summary: The storage, publication and recipe-state design is close to implementable, but the biggest gap is that 'producer identity' (what it is made of, and whether a mismatch re-baselines or refuses) is never defined, which leaves several connector and citation shapes open too.

questions.text: What makes up the stored producer identity (plugin, package source, payload contract, instance config), and on a mismatch does fetch start a fresh baseline or refuse until an explicit clear?
questions.reason: Decides the index producer field and which edits make captures unreadable; ADR says only 'bound to producing plugin source and payload contract' and 'successful refetch replaces the capture'.

questions.text: What is the folder connector's evidence ID, and which path form (relative, as configured, or resolved absolute) goes into the host SHA-256 fingerprint?
questions.reason: Fixes fingerprint stability across checkout moves and whether a directory switch updates or removes/adds; ADR defines the framed hash over 'the UTF-8 source path' without its form.

questions.text: What is the folder connector's payload type, and how are binary or non-UTF-8 files handled?
questions.reason: Persisted payload contract and whether one binary file blocks every fetch; ADR gives only FolderConfig and 'host file acquisition can supply the hash alongside the text'.

questions.text: For mail or Teams items already outside retention at first discovery, must content and attachments still be downloaded, and does the fingerprint cover blob contents or only metadata?
questions.reason: Sets download cost, failure surface and the fingerprint projection; ADR says born-truncated items need 'a stable observed projection' but also 'fingerprint the captured payload'.

questions.text: Does EvidenceRef.producer hold the plugin name or the storage producer identity (package/contract)?
questions.reason: Persisted citation wire format and whether citations survive plugin edits; ADR says only 'Producer and instanceName identify the integration and instance'.

questions.text: When a folder is added to (or removed from) a mail instance with existing positions, what initial since does it use, and may a supplied since apply to it?
questions.reason: Changes option validation and position seeding; ADR rejects a supplied boundary 'once a position exists' though positions are per folder.

questions.text: Do the mail and Teams connectors ever restore truncated payloads to Available (e.g. after retentionDays increases), re-downloading by ID outside the delta feed?
questions.reason: Decides whether a per-ID refetch path exists or truncation is one-way; the generic contract allows restoration but the connectors 'ignore changes to already captured messages'.

questions.text: Does payload/blob reclamation run under the instance lock, and does it delete only old-minus-new references or sweep all unreferenced files?
questions.reason: Outside the lock a reclaim can delete a file a concurrent publication just reused; ADR puts steps 1-2 under the lock but is silent for step 4 and on who cleans staging leftovers.

questions.text: Is SetEvidencePayload with Available allowed on an entry that is already Available, replacing content under the same fingerprint?
questions.reason: Allowing it bypasses the same-fingerprint UpdatedEvidence refusal; ADR covers Truncated-to-Available and repeated Truncated only.

questions.text: When a stateful connector's configuration changes after a position exists (calendar window, mail mailbox/folders, Files globs), who detects it and does it reset, reconcile or start a new producer?
questions.reason: Host-vs-connector ownership of config-change detection; only Files says 'a changed source configuration starts a new producer', while calendar follows the saved delta link verbatim.

questions.text: What fields does the calendar Event payload carry (e.g. join URL, series IDs, attendees, body)?
questions.reason: Persisted payload shape and fingerprint scope, and whether curation can link artifacts to events offline; ADR names only source links and lastModifiedDateTime.

questions.text: How does Files folderPath combine with each scope (especially a SharedUrl resolving to a file), and how are non-business drives acquired?
questions.reason: Decides validation and whether a second delta strategy is needed; ADR specifies only 'drive-root delta for the business-drive path'.

questions.text: Which guest fetch signature is normative, the generic list-of-changes one or the FetchContext/FetchResult one, and how do options and prior position reach the connector?
questions.reason: Sets the SDK type every connector implements and the host dispatch; the two signatures differ and the generic one has no options parameter.

questions.text: May a batch contain several operations for the same ID, and are delta checks made against the running state or the prior capture?
questions.reason: Determines validator design and which fingerprint the same-fingerprint rule compares; ADR says only 'the host applies changes in order'.

questions.text: Does the SDK define host-recognised FetchError constructors for truncated, missing-ID and corrupt-storage read failures, or does each plugin author its own?
questions.reason: Shared error type ownership; ADR requires CLI/MCP to expose the distinction but not where the constructors live.

questions.text: How are FetchSummary added/updated/removed counted (per operation or net), and do SetEvidencePayload operations count?
questions.reason: Operator-visible summary semantics; ADR says payload-only ops are not additions/updates/removals but gives the summary nowhere to record them.

questions.text: What format and validation apply to mail's since option and to retentionDays (zero, negative, future)?
questions.reason: Connector-owned validation rules; calendar windows are specified as timezone-qualified ISO 8601 but since is untyped Text.

questions.text: What are the Teams connector's configuration and fetch-options types, including the look-back window representation?
questions.reason: Determines what callers pass to --options and how it is validated; ADR describes them only in prose.

questions.text: What reference time ('now') does retention truncation use: invocation start time or publish time?
questions.reason: Affects which items are truncated in a given fetch; ADR says retention uses received/ended time but not the comparison instant.
